articles.summary: The second Breakthrough Device Designation awarded to AVIM Therapy underscores its potential in a defined high-risk population and supports an accelerated development pathway.
articles.title: Strengthening AVIM Therapy’s Regulatory Pathway: A Second FDA Breakthrough Device Designation

articles.summary: Recently presented clinical and mechanistic findings reinforce the potential of Atrioventricular Interval Modulation Therapy (“AVIM Therapy”) to immediately reduce blood pressure and have a favorable cardiac hemodynamic impact, expanding its potential therapeutic relevance beyond hypertension into hypertensive heart disease.
articles.title: From Blood Pressure Reduction to Cardiac Function: What New AVIM Therapy Data Signal
